# Rescore the AIM33 ortholog set with the benchmark-validated positional rule.
# (the OrthoDB fasta endpoint returns nothing when species=all is passed; omitting it works)
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, json
from collections import Counter

AAs = "ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62 = """ 4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
-1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
 0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
 0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
-1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
 1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
 0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
MM = np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B62.strip().split("\n")], float)
idx = {a: i for i, a in enumerate(AAs)}; GAP = -8.0
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c, -1) for c in s])

def nw_map(s1, s2):
    a, b = enc(s1), enc(s2); n, m = len(a), len(b)
    Sub = np.where((a[:, None] >= 0) & (b[None, :] >= 0),
                   MM[np.clip(a, 0, 19)[:, None], np.clip(b, 0, 19)[None, :]], -1.0)
    M_ = np.full((n+1, m+1), -1e9); M_[0, :] = 0.0; M_[:, 0] = np.arange(n+1)*GAP
    jj = np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        cand = np.full(m+1, -1e9)
        cand[1:] = np.maximum(M_[i-1, :-1] + Sub[i-1, :], M_[i-1, 1:] + GAP)
        cand[0] = M_[i-1, 0] + GAP
        M_[i, :] = np.maximum.accumulate(cand - jj*GAP) + jj*GAP
    i, j = n, int(np.argmax(M_[n, :])); mp = {}
    while i > 0 and j > 0:
        if abs(M_[i, j] - (M_[i-1, j-1] + Sub[i-1, j-1])) < 1e-6:
            mp[i] = s2[j-1]; i -= 1; j -= 1
        elif abs(M_[i, j] - (M_[i-1, j] + GAP)) < 1e-6: i -= 1
        else: j -= 1
    return mp

A = "".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q04516.fasta", timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
txt = requests.get("https://data.orthodb.org/current/fasta", params={"id": "22973at4891"}, timeout=180).text
recs, hdr, buf = [], None, []
for line in txt.split("\n"):
    if line.startswith(">"):
        if hdr is not None: recs.append((hdr, "".join(buf)))
        hdr, buf = line[1:].strip(), []
    else: buf.append(line.strip())
if hdr is not None: recs.append((hdr, "".join(buf)))
def org(h):
    try: return json.loads(h[h.index("{"):])["organism_name"]
    except Exception: return "?"
recs = [(org(h), s) for h, s in recs if 150 <= len(s) <= 700]
n = len(recs)
print(f"orthologs {n}, species {len(set(o for o, _ in recs))}")

acid, basic = set("DE"), set("KR")
rows = []
for o, s in recs:
    mp = nw_map(A, s)
    c216, c244, c256 = mp.get(216, "-"), mp.get(244, "-"), mp.get(256, "-")
    if c244 in basic or c256 in basic: call = "NADPH"
    elif c244 in acid or c216 in acid: call = "NADH"
    else: call = "neutral"
    rows.append((o, c216, c244, c256, call))

calls = Counter(r[4] for r in rows)
print("\nPositional rule (basic at 244 or 256 = NADPH; else acidic at 216 or 244 = NADH):")
for k in ("NADH", "NADPH", "neutral"):
    print(f"  {k:8s} {calls[k]:4d}  ({100*calls[k]/n:5.1f}%)")

old = Counter()
for _, c216, c244, c256, _ in rows:
    p = [c216, c244]; a = any(c in acid for c in p); b = any(c in basic for c in p)
    old["NADH" if a and not b else "NADPH" if b and not a else "mixed" if a and b else "neutral"] += 1
print("\nEarlier symmetric rule, same data:")
for k, v in old.most_common(): print(f"  {k:8s} {v:4d}  ({100*v/n:5.1f}%)")

print("\nColumn composition:")
comp = {}
for lab, i in (("216", 1), ("244", 2), ("256", 3)):
    c = Counter(r[i] for r in rows); comp[lab] = c
    print(f"  col {lab}: " + ", ".join(f"{a} {100*v/n:.1f}%" for a, v in c.most_common(5))
          + f"   | acidic {100*sum(v for a,v in c.items() if a in acid)/n:.1f}%"
          + f", basic {100*sum(v for a,v in c.items() if a in basic)/n:.1f}%")
print(f"\nS. cerevisiae triad E216/H244/Y256 frequency in the set: "
      f"{sum(1 for r in rows if (r[1],r[2],r[3])==('E','H','Y'))}/{n}")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11.5, 4.4))
ks = ["NADH", "NADPH", "neutral"]
axes[0].bar(ks, [calls[k] for k in ks], color=["#1f4e79", "#c00000", "#bbbbbb"])
for i, k in enumerate(ks):
    axes[0].text(i, calls[k]+2, f"{calls[k]}\n{100*calls[k]/n:.1f}%", ha="center", fontsize=9)
axes[0].set_ylabel(f"orthologs (n = {n})")
axes[0].set_ylim(0, max(calls.values())*1.25)
axes[0].set_title("Donor call across the AIM33 clade,\nrule validated at 8/9 on known enzymes", fontsize=10)

x = np.arange(3); labels = ["col 216", "col 244", "col 256"]
fa = [100*sum(1 for r in rows if r[i] in acid)/n for i in (1, 2, 3)]
fb = [100*sum(1 for r in rows if r[i] in basic)/n for i in (1, 2, 3)]
fn = [100-a-b for a, b in zip(fa, fb)]
axes[1].bar(x, fa, color="#1f4e79", label="Asp or Glu")
axes[1].bar(x, fn, bottom=fa, color="#dddddd", label="neutral")
axes[1].bar(x, fb, bottom=np.array(fa)+np.array(fn), color="#c00000", label="Lys or Arg")
for i in range(3):
    axes[1].text(i, fa[i]/2, f"{fa[i]:.0f}%", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color="white")
    if fb[i] > 4: axes[1].text(i, 100-fb[i]/2, f"{fb[i]:.0f}%", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9, color="white")
axes[1].set_xticks(x); axes[1].set_xticklabels(labels); axes[1].set_ylabel("% of orthologs")
axes[1].legend(fontsize=8, loc="center right")
axes[1].set_title("Charge class at the three pocket columns", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
